terms.comment: Our formation (locūtiō nostra): the plural of Traupman’s auscultābulum, a telephone receiver (p. 124), from auscultāre, to listen. Morgan–Owens and Andresian have conchae acūsticae (below) for the large kind that covers the ears, and Morgan–Owens leaves earphones and earbuds without a word.
Morgan–Owens leaves small earphones and earbuds without a word.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 124.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. headphone. Anna Andresian, Vocabula Picta (2014), p. 15.
